steps.content:
Neither — if you want the manufacturer warranty, **don't buy from either one.**

On paper those 2 listings are identical:

* **A - Ottervale Audio:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2, $129.00, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days, 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping, 1-year limited warranty.
* **B - Brackmoor Sound:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2, $129.00, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days, 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping, 1-year limited warranty.

Both pages also say the exact same thing:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

And both link to the same list: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/tbyx9p/dealers

That list says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Ottervale Audio is not on that list. Brackmoor Sound is not on that list.**

So both sellers are claiming authorized status + full manufacturer warranty, while linking to the official proof that they are *not* authorized. That means you can't trust the warranty claim on either listing, and you have a higher risk of grey-market / counterfeit / no-warranty support.

If you want these headphones with a real Quellwyn warranty, buy from one of the actual authorized dealers instead: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
